_comment: The embedder registry: everything that varies from one embedder to the next, in
one place, keyed by model identity.
WHERE THESE RUN. In the aimee-kb container. The kb loads the model itself from
`repo`@`revision`; there is no GGUF, no llama.cpp and no aimee-llm hop on the embed
path. That is what lets the aimee-llm container be retired: with the reranker gone
and the embedder in-container, nothing is left for it to serve on the retrieval side.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. These facts used to be scattered across three files —
coordinates in aimee-llm-supervisor.sh's embed_coords(), pooling ~110 lines away in
the same script, prefixes in aimee_llm_gateway.py, the width in src/headers/aimee.h.
Two of them fail SILENTLY when wrong, and both have already gone wrong:
- pooling defaulted to `last`, correct for Qwen3 and wrong for nomic. Wrong
pooling yields vectors that are correctly shaped, correctly normalised and
simply wrong. Nothing errors; recall collapses.
- prefixes were absent entirely, so nomic served at 0.5823 NDCG@10 instead of
the 0.6075 it was selected on — below the runner-up it was chosen over.
Switching or adding an embedder should be one entry here, not a scavenger hunt across
three languages. Anything that is per-model belongs in this file; anything derived at
runtime (the deployed dimension: pinned > recorded > probed) does not.
EVERY FIELD IS REQUIRED, including empty prefixes. A model whose card defines no
prefixes declares that with empty strings — readers distinguish 'declared none'
from 'not registered', and refuse to serve the latter rather than guess.
Derive these from the model card, never by copying the previous entry. `prefixes`
comes from the card's usage section, `pooling` from its 1_Pooling/config.json, `dim`
from that file's word_embedding_dimension, and `context` from max_trained_positions
(NOT the tokenizer's model_max_length, which is often a smaller artifact).

notes: The default and the quality choice: 0.6075 NDCG@10 on frozen-ab-v1 (10,000 cases /
26,473 documents) WITH these prefixes. Serving it without them measures 0.5823,
below the runner-up it was chosen over.
context 2048 is max_trained_positions; the tokenizer's model_max_length of 512 is
Loaded in-container from repo@revision. The GGUF coordinates that used to live here
(ggml-org/Nomic-Embed-Text-V2-GGUF, q8_0) are gone with the aimee-llm embed path;
the -0.0037 NDCG@10 that Q8_0 quantisation cost goes with them.
The CPU choice: 0.5909 NDCG@10, ~6x nomic's CPU throughput and half the vector
storage. Its card defines NO prefixes, so the empty pair above is a declaration,
not a gap — and its benchmark number carries into production unchanged.
384-dim, confirmed against the card's 1_Pooling/config.json and our own table in
which was wrong. Choosing between it and nomic is therefore a DIMENSION change
(768 <-> 384): the pgvector columns are rebuilt as well as the corpus re-embedded.
